summary: The Huberman Lab motivation episode adds a self-regulation and work-initiation branch: [[MotivationRewardEffortCalculation]] links procrastination and action to reward, perceived effort, prior learning, feedback, planning, and social meaning; [[ApathyActionInitiation]] and [[DopamineInvertedU]] keep neurological and stimulant claims source-scoped, while [[AttentionCapacitySelection]] treats focus as limited selection rather than willpower alone. EP279 adds a smart-vehicle social-space branch: owners use vehicles as commute buffers, mobile meeting and rest rooms, parent-child cabins, and outdoor staging spaces, while assisted driving changes attention practices without removing responsibility. Hanji 882 adds a premodern status-discipline case: public reward and reputation need rightful grounding, because overlarge honors can become exposure while refusal can preserve social legitimacy. Hanji 887 adds a premodern role-capacity and social-liability case: formal rank and moral intent fail when timing, secrecy, palace access, and execution channels are uncontrolled, and students, followers, old subordinates, family, and recommendation ties become punishable networks after failure. Hanji 893 adds a premodern status-and-social-order case: scholar reputation and recommendation, normally career-making signals, become institutional liability when a captured court turns recognition networks into a death-facing persecution map. Hanji 1035 adds a source-scoped work/social-order branch: useful roles, trust, and low-risk value are used as a modern analogy, while the historical material ties patron choice and returning-labor settlement to organizational capacity before Guandu. The Marketplace Tech smart-glasses branch makes creator and lifestyle-work AI hardware depend on hands-free task fit, bystander privacy, consent, and gendered marketing, not only model capability. The Li Ji Fuyou Tiandi episode adds that AI-era and historical education also require question consciousness, oral-history listening, source judgment, and refusal of simple labels, not just fact retrieval. The Planet Money Antarctica finale adds a living-conditions branch: isolated scientific work at McMurdo depends on constrained retail and recreation, while parking, social housing, and consortio finance show everyday options shaped by institutional rules beyond individual effort. EP278 adds an AI-era education and career branch: major choice cannot be reduced to a safe label when standardized junior work may be compressed, so durable formation comes from foundations, occupational cognition, field contact, upstream questions, trust, verification, and non-algorithmic capabilities. Hanji 904 adds a premodern career-entry case before the Sun Jian and Hongdu sequence: Cao Cao formal Xiaolian/langguan path works through Cao Teng/Cao Song family access, Qiao Xuan/Xu Shao public appraisal, and Sima Fang appointment judgment, so status, reputation, and office placement are already linked before later reputation-infrastructure claims. Hanji 905 adds a premodern visibility case: Sun Jian's crisis role turns capacity into public career capital, while the Xiping Stone Classics make education order depend on shared textual standards at Taixue. Hanji 909 adds a premodern decision-and-command prelude: Cai Yong warns against deep Xianbei war, Wang Fu-sponsored command selection, and the Xianbei defeat join institutional judgment to work-and-social-order analysis. Hanji 910 then adds a premodern education-and-social-order prelude: Hongdu Menxue turns learning routes into office-channel competition, while Zhao Bao makes family vulnerability part of a loyalty-collateral dilemma under frontier pressure. The 2026-08-24 The Intelligence source adds a cohort-scarring branch: Japan's employment ice age generation shows that a weak labor-market entry window can shape wages, housing, pensions, and household formation long after the initial downturn. The work, education, and society material emphasizes implementation over capability claims: AI, software, creative production, physical products, research, creator work, finance, public building, and institutional roles all depend on workflow ownership, distribution, verification, trust, supply chains, labor constraints, and human judgment. Hanji 986 adds a premodern organizational case where coercive command breaks feedback and base security determines whether expansion is practical. Hanji 999 adds a premodern social-order case where grain, agricultural labor, protection, and family safety condition whether authority and alliances hold. Hanji 926 adds a reputation-infrastructure case where elite evaluators and circulated labels can certify a politically ambiguous actor, while the same judgment system can also constrain talent recognition. The Wudang episode adds a Daoist fieldwork and life-design branch: quitting work and going up the mountain become analytically useful only after romantic retreat stories are grounded in temple shifts, chores, bodily discomfort, tourist mediation, family obligations, fieldnote practice, and a Zhuangzi-style freedom based on reducing dependence on external scoring. Hanji 1031 contributes a bounded self-knowledge analogy: Dunning-Kruger and rational-humility language is kept source-scoped, while the cross-topic lesson is that leadership confidence needs external feedback and shared-risk tests. The Rubin source adds a creative-work process branch: creative output depends on felt judgment, phase-specific work, feedback boundaries, focus/release rhythms, and private completion pressure rather than applying one productivity rule to every stage. The Gottfried episode adds a women-health decision and communication layer: hormone, contraception, PCOS, perimenopause, and midlife-screening evidence depends on clear consent language, information triage, symptom legitimacy, and clinician-patient context rather than isolated tips.
